nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/IrO2 probe mentioned for pH measurement during localized corrosion of AZ31B magnesium alloy with PEDOT coating (Tefashe et al. [8]), but no specific data reported in this review.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Tefashe et al. used a Pt/IrO2 probe to measure pH during localized corrosion of AZ31B magnesium alloy electrochemically coated with poly(3,4- ethylenedioxythiophene) (PEDOT).

nodes.characterization_summary: Au/IrO2 probe mentioned for pH measurement above copper surface during nitrate reduction (Santos et al. [9]), but no specific data reported in this review.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Other metal supports can also be used, as seen in the work of Santos and co-workers[9], where pH above a copper surface during nitrate reduction was measured with a Au/IrO2 probe.

nodes.characterization_summary: PANI coated Pt ultramicroelectrode mentioned for monitoring extracellular pH of MCF-7 cells (Song et al. [10]), but no specific data reported in this review.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Recently Song et al. reported the use of a PANI coated Pt ultramicroelectrode to monitor the extracellular pH of MCF-7 cells under electrical stimulation.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt nanoelectrode using PtO reduction voltammetry mentioned for probing pH during ORR over silver gas diffusion electrode (Botz et al. [14]), but no specific data reported in this review.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Botz et al. used the PtO reduction voltammetry to successfully probe pH during oxygen reduction (ORR) over a silver gas diffusion electrode as can be seen in Figure 1d.

nodes.characterization_summary: Syringaldazine film-based voltammetric pH nanosensor mentioned for probing pH during ORR above Pt-UME (Michalak et al. [15]), but no specific data reported in this review.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Michalak et al. have also probed pH during ORR using a voltammetric pH nanosensor based on a syringaldazine film. The pH map obtained above a Pt-UME is shown in Figure 1c.

nodes.characterization_summary: 4-NTP self-assembled monolayer on Au-UME presented as pH sensor for CO2 reduction measurements (M.C.O. Monteiro et al. unpublished), but no specific data reported in this review.
nodes.evidence_snippet: We have recently presented a pH sensor that overcomes film limitations, based on a self-assembled monolayer of 4-nitrothiophenol (4-NTP) on a Au-UME... This enables, for instance, pH measurements during CO2 reduction on gold using SECM, as shown in Figure 1e (M.C.O. Monteiro et al. unpublished).
